startup_observations.summary: PMCP catalog exposes index-it-mcp and reports the Code-Index-MCP query tool surface online.
pmcp status --json --server index-it-mcp --probe reports index-it-mcp online with 8 tools from user-scoped PMCP configuration.
PMCP-mediated get_status reached index-it-mcp 1.2.0 and reported an empty repository list with status unknown.
PMCP doctor reports that the repo-local command-mode code-index-mcp config conflicts with the active system PMCP service and should use the remote gateway URL instead.

startup_constraints.summary: PMCP can start index-it-mcp, but the PMCP-managed runtime currently reports no registered repositories for downstream query work.
